offers_products.reason: Sells freight forwarding and logistics services; tracking technology supports the service, and it owns no aircraft, ships or trucks.

offers_services.reason: Air and ocean freight forwarding, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution for shippers such as Toyota, Nissan and Goodyear.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are manufacturers, retailers and aerospace firms shipping cargo, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves businesses such as Toyota, Nissan, Goodyear, The Kooples and pharmaceutical companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Shippers repeatedly book freight and logistics on ongoing supply chain programs, though without fixed contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Freight volumes fall when trade and manufacturing and retail goods demand decline.

big_ticket.reason: Individual shipments are frequent, routine purchases for customers.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the global network, buying freight capacity and technology platforms, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers include large enterprises like Toyota, Nissan, Goodyear and big pharmaceutical companies.

asset_heavy.reason: States it doesn't own aircraft, ships or trucks; it buys capacity from carriers.
